verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only building blocks: built-in metrics that can be enabled in configuration (pipecat-docs-5), transcript collection via turn events (pipecat-docs-4), audio recording (pipecat-docs-3), and Whisker, a pipeline debugger for frames and latency (pipecat-comm-4). Nothing shows a ready-made dashboard for call success rates, durations, outcomes or sentiment, so a founder would still have to build their own analytics on top of these primitives.
